project.title: Charity Fund Collection Mobile Application
project.shortDescription: Cross-platform donation mobile app featuring Stripe payments and real-time synchronization.
project.description: Built a cross-platform charity donation mobile app supporting secure donations and real-time updates. Developed admin dashboards and integrated chatbot support for FAQs. Implemented Firebase Authentication and Firestore for secure real-time data synchronization.
features: Stripe payment gateway integration for secure donation transfers.
AI-driven automated FAQs chatbot for rapid user queries.
Live fund tracker showing total collections and target visualizers.
Automated tax-receipt PDF generation via EmailJS.
